title: androsace rotundifolia subsp. glandulosa
intro: Androsace rotundifolia subsp. glandulosa, commonly known as the alpine rose, is a plant species in the Primulaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as its ability to protect against cardiovascular diseases and certain types of cancer. The therapeutic actions of Androsace rotundifolia subsp. glandulosa include its role as a cardiotonic, diuretic, and expectorant, which can help alleviate symptoms of hypertension, fluid retention, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
